fields.name: Delay
fields.evidence: Game name of the struct: ecl::sound::HoverMixStateComponent::HoverTimerData (macOS HashMap<EntityHandle, HoverTimerData> instantiation). EoCClient.dll+0xDA9B10 (called from HoverMixStateSystem::UpdateTargets) subtracts the frame delta from +0 every frame and, when it reaches <= 0, emits a HoverRTPCRequest and removes the entry (FixedStrings HoverStateMixEnterDelayTime / HoverStateMixLeaveDelayTime exist for the start values).

fields.name: Value
fields.evidence: UpdateTargets (EoCClient.dll+0xDAB790) stores 1.0 (entity still hovered/targeted, ref count > 0) or 0.0 at +4 and compares it before re-arming; EoCClient.dll+0xDA9B10 copies +4 into the RTPC request's value.

fields.name: Entity
fields.evidence: Game name: ecl::sound::HoverMixStateComponent::HoverRTPCRequest. EoCClient.dll+0xDA9B10 writes the HashMap key (an entity handle) at +0 of each element (stride 0x10). Same shape as ls::GameplaySoundRTPCRequest (GameEngine.dll+0x1C42A0: handle, FixedString, float).

fields.name: RTPC
fields.evidence: EoCClient.dll+0xDA9B10 copies a global FixedString (probably "Mix_IsHovered", registered next to the hover delay names) into +8; HoverMixStateSystem::Update (EoCClient.dll+0xDAB6A0) destroys element+8 when clearing the array.

fields.name: PlayerTargets
fields.evidence: HoverMixStateSystem::UpdateTargets (EoCClient.dll+0xDAB790) walks keys at +0x20 with stride 2 (a signed short player id taken from PlayerTargetEntityChangedOneFrameComponent+8, hashed as short) and values at +0x30 with stride 8 (entity handles from the same one-frame component); inserts with FUN_18054ed60. The game key type is short (int16), declared here as uint16_t. Live: bucket count 5, one entry.

fields.name: HoverTimers
fields.evidence: macOS: ls::HashMap<ls::ID<EntityHandleTraits>, ecl::sound::HoverMixStateComponent::HoverTimerData>::RemoveNode. UpdateTargets uses +0x40 as a hash map with 8-byte keys at +0x60 and 8-byte values at +0x70; EoCClient.dll+0xDA9B10 counts down the timers.

fields.name: RTPCRequests
fields.evidence: HoverMixStateSystem::Update (EoCClient.dll+0xDAB6A0) clears IndexedStorage<HoverMixStateComponent::HoverRTPCRequest> at +0x80 (size +0x8C, capacity +0x88, stride 0x10) every frame; EoCClient.dll+0xDA9B10 appends to it. macOS default constructor zeroes 0x00-0x8F.

open_questions: Exact FixedString in RTPCRequests.RTPC (global EoCClient.dll+0x1A36AB8, not resolved by fixedstrings; likely Mix_IsHovered).
PlayerTargets key is a signed short in the game (declared uint16_t here).
